title: Scope alpha gate parsing to required gates
summary: Alpha bundle validation should only satisfy evidence commands from the Required Gates section so copied command lines elsewhere in validation.md cannot satisfy release acceptance.
expectedFailureModes: A command line outside Required Gates satisfies release acceptance.
Duplicate command lines inside and outside Required Gates produce ambiguous evidence.
Docs imply any matching command line in validation notes is enough.
humanEscalation: Published bundle format changes require human approval once real public release evidence exists.
nextAction: Parse the Required Gates section explicitly, validate gate result lines only from that section, add regression coverage, and document the section-scoped contract.
